answer: Require every identity to pass an in-person driving licence road test at an official centre, examined in a real vehicle, so a quill cannot sign a fable that a sparrow never drove. Each fake identity costs at least 150 dollars for the test plus vehicle hire, so 10 fakes cost at least 1,500 dollars and 100 fakes at least 15,000 dollars, and the cost rises further with more fakes because examiners, vehicles and test slots are scarce.
